description: This file contains the transformProps function for a Heatmap chart in Apache Superset, converting chart properties into ECharts options including data processing, axis sorting, and tooltip formatting.

methods.name: extractUniqueValues
methods.description: Extracts unique non-null, non-undefined values from a specified column in the dataset.

methods.name: sortAxisValues
methods.description: Sorts axis values based on specified options: alphabetically (numeric-aware) or by aggregated metric value.

methods.name: calculateTotals
methods.description: Calculates total sums for x and y categories and overall total, memoized for performance.
